attr.title: Hard Truck 2: King of the Road
attr.desc: Trucking across a big open map: haul cargo, buy better trucks, race rivals and dodge the mafia and the police. A static recompilation of the PC game (king.exe) to native aarch64, drawing with OpenGL ES.
attr.inst: Copy your own Hard Truck 2: King of the Road install (the GOG release) into ports/hardtruck2/gamedata, so that king.exe is in that folder.
